findings.title: update action renders without saving anything
findings.body: The `update` action never reads params or persists changes; it just re-renders the embedding. The admin page's saveChanges calls `embedding.update({})` against this PUT route, so any submitted changes are silently discarded while the client sees success.

findings.title: update/destroy crash with NoMethodError on unknown id
findings.body: `EmbeddableHost.where(id: ...).first` can return nil; `save_host(host)` then calls `host.host=` and `host.destroy` on nil, raising a 500 instead of a 404.

findings.title: Category is silently reset to uncategorized when omitted on update
findings.body: save_host unconditionally assigns category_id from params and falls back to uncategorized when blank, so any update that doesn't send category_id moves the host to the uncategorized category.

findings.title: before_validation mutates nil host and mutates in place
findings.body: `self.host.sub!` raises NoMethodError when host is nil (e.g. a create request with no host param), and `sub!` mutates the string in place, which can affect frozen or shared strings. The presence validation is never reached because the callback crashes first.

findings.title: Host lookup is case-insensitive only on the stored side, and host with port is not matched
findings.body: record_for_host compares `lower(host)` against `uri.host`, which drops any port. Hosts stored with a port (the validator allows `:port`) can never match, and the stored value is never normalized to lowercase, so mixed-case input is handled inconsistently.

findings.title: Topic created with nil category when no host matches
findings.body: `eh.try(:category_id)` passes nil when the URL has no matching EmbeddableHost, so PostCreator falls back to defaults instead of the previous embed_category behaviour; import of a URL from a host not in the list is also not guarded by any host check at this point.

findings.title: Referer host check bypassed by a host with no records but dev admin
findings.body: The ensure_embeddable check is skipped entirely for development admins, and the removed 'embeddable hosts not set' guard means an empty table now only relies on host_allowed?; combined with the lenient record_for_host this loosens the embed origin restriction compared with the previous behaviour.

findings.title: Migration SQL injection and fragile category lookup
findings.body: Host values from the existing site setting are interpolated directly into INSERT SQL without escaping, so a value containing a single quote breaks the migration or injects SQL. Also `[0]['id']` raises NoMethodError when no row matches, and `category_id == 0` is used as a sentinel for not found.

findings.title: cmd_tuples check on SELECT result is wrong API usage
findings.body: cmd_tuples is meant for write commands; for a SELECT the row count is available via ntuples/num_tuples. The guard is unreliable and should be replaced with a row count check.

findings.title: Removal of embeddable_hosts setting breaks plugins and existing callers
findings.body: The `allows_embeddable_host?` method and the `embeddable_hosts`/`embed_category` settings are removed without a compatibility shim, while topic.rb, topic_embed.rb and other callers are updated only in this diff; any other code still calling SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts will raise.

findings.title: Category save uses Category.findById result that may be nil
findings.body: After saving, `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(...))` is set without checking the category exists, so a stale or nil category id leaves the badge rendering broken; also the save() props only include 'host' from buffered, so buffered changes to other fields are dropped.

findings.title: saveChanges sends an empty update, so the Save action does nothing
findings.body: `this.get('embedding').update({})` sends no data, so there's no way to persist anything from the embedding page; combined with the server-side no-op update, the page's save path is non-functional.

findings.title: Controller specs only check inheritance, no behaviour tested
findings.body: The new admin controller specs only assert the class inherits from AdminController. create, update, destroy and the category fallback are untested, which is why the update/destroy nil and category reset bugs go unnoticed. The same applies to embedding_controller_spec.

findings.title: Unused local variables reintroduced in for_digest specs
findings.body: The diff removes unused `topic =` assignments in these examples, which is fine, but the expandable_first_post? block was restructured so that the 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' test no longer clearly isolates the missing-host case.
